Number of studies.evidence_source: The text describes correlations without explicitly naming or numbering distinct studies.

section_summary.extract_value: This section, titled 'Character strengths and Big Five', details the correlations between various character strengths and the Big Five personality traits. It reports positive correlations between character strengths and Agreeableness, Extraversion, and Conscientiousness, as well as negative correlations with Neuroticism. Openness to Experience was found to be positively correlated only with the Forgiveness of Self subscale.
section_summary.evidence_source: The entire text content of section 4.2 'Character strengths and Big Five' was used to create this summary.
